name: last-shell-web
description: Browser multiplayer version of Last Shell (server-authoritative).

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lastshell/server && npm run test -w @lastshell/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lastshell/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lastshell/server && npm run typecheck -w @lastshell/web
